paragraphs.source_en: Sakuma Morimasa was indulging in pleasant dreams, waiting for Kuwayama Shigeharu to meekly surrender his position on Mount Shizugatake, when Niwa Nagahide’s reinforcements suddenly appeared and Kuwayama’s troops, who had once withdrawn down the mountain, wheeled around and counterattacked. With no other choice, Morimasa abandoned his attack for that night.
